notes: No measured lung cancer value is reported in this document. The 24 value(s) listed are targets or recommended maximum times it states (value_kind "target"), not results. This document (THL Ohjaus 21/2016, watermarked 'Vanhentunut' / outdated) is a methodological, classification, and coding guideline for monitoring access to cancer care in Finland via the Hilmo register starting 1.1.2017. It contains no empirical or statistical indicator values for lung cancer (C33-C34) or actual measured waiting times/pathway performance by area or nationally. It only includes ICD-10 and procedure code tables, general target timeframes from a 2010 STM report (e.g. 6 weeks maximum from referral to first treatment in suspected cancer on p. 14), recommended maximum waiting times specifically for breast, prostate, and colorectal cancer pathways (pp. 19-20), reporting bin definitions (p. 45), and brief descriptions of waiting-time targets in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and England (pp. 14-15).
